subject: Re: Case study kickoff — Aurelia Health availability & recording permission

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Case study kickoff: brief intro + proposed agenda (recording consent)

Hi Elena & Tom,

Thanks again for agreeing to participate — we're excited to spotlight Aurelia Health. I wanted to propose a short discovery call to capture the outcomes and technical details we can include in the case study.

Suggested length: 45 minutes
Proposed agenda (high level):
- 5m introductions & context
- 10m business impact (before/after metrics)
- 10m technical implementation (models, infra, private vs hosted)
- 10m results and anecdotes (user impact, cost/latency wins)
- 10m follow-ups/next steps and approvals

Would you be available Wed 9/9 or Thu 9/10 in the morning PT? If those don't work, feel free to propose times.

One logistical note: we'd like to record the session (video + audio) for internal note-taking and for a short edited clip in the case study. If that's not OK, we can take detailed notes instead. I'll attach a one-pager and a draft release form for your legal team's review.

Attachments: redwood_case_onepager.pdf (pdf), release_form.docx (docx)

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Subject: Re: internal — Aurelia case study: stakeholders & agenda

Mina / team,

Note from planning: Elena asked for the technical topics list — attaching a short checklist below we should include in the final invite so Aurelia can bring the right SMEs.

Suggested technical checklist (2–3 bullets we will ask them to prepare):
- Model selection & variants used (open model name, quantization, any fine-tuning)
- Deployment topology (hosted vs dedicated vs private, region, KMS)
- Observability highlights (latency percentiles, token costs, KV/prefix caching settings)
- Any special integrations (EHR connectors, PHI handling, compliance notes)

I recommend we have Connor cover runtime/obs and Priyom cover cost/quantization findings. I'll take the business-impact questions.

Also, let's request permission to record and offer to share the raw recording and a short transcript for their approval before publish.

Marissa
Sr. Customer Marketing Manager
